risks.title: Subscription dependency and customer churn
risks.score_rationale: The text notes that revenues primarily derive from subscriptions and that customers can add, remove, or cancel services. Increased customer churn could negatively impact recurring revenues (ASV).

risks.title: Acquisition integration and costs
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions that revenue and headcount growth is partially driven by acquisitions (Irwin, Liquid Holdings). Successful integration and cost management of acquisitions are critical for future performance.

risks.title: Rising cost of services
risks.score_rationale: Cost of services increased 8.5%, faster than revenues (5.4%). Increasing amortization of intangibles and personnel costs weigh on margins.

risks.title: Intensifying competition in financial data market
risks.score_rationale: While not explicitly detailed in this excerpt, the financial platform market is inherently competitive. Continuous innovation and maintaining an attractive offering is essential.

risks.title: Tax litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions charges related to a 'Sales Tax Dispute' in the prior year, which had significant impact on SG&A. Though resolved or ongoing, similar future disputes could occur.

risks.title: Dependence on headcount growth in centers of excellence
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of headcount (68%) is concentrated in centers of excellence (Philippines, India). Disruption in these regions or difficulty attracting/retaining talent could impact operations.

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions impact of FX fluctuations on revenues (0.1% in 2025). While currently modest, increased volatility could have more significant impact.
